correctness.rationale: Every rank-one nilpotent is vφ with φ(v)=0; tr(Cvφ)=φ(Cv); this vanishes for a nonzero nilpotent exactly if C has a rational eigenvector. Irreducible quadratic conjugacy classes have size q(q−1); scalar quotient yields q²(q−1)/2 hyperplanes. Trace normalization and ± similarity in the odd trace-zero case give all orbit sizes. The standalone verifier independently exhausts q=2,3,4,5; infinite generality follows from the proof, not finite testing.
